verdict.rationale:
Zep explicitly documents 'Custom Entity/Edge Types' — Pydantic-like classes to customize entity/relation creation and retrieval in the Context Graph — and its underlying Graphiti framework supports both prescribed and learned ontologies. This directly satisfies the ml-engineer's need to tailor the schema to their domain.
missing for 10: detailed examples/limits of custom ontology definitions, and independent hands-on validation beyond docs (one community comment requests firmer RDF/OWL-style ontology control, suggesting some non-determinism in schema application).
